topic: What your old iPhone is actually worth on Apple Trade In, and why the number on the page is a ceiling not a quote
details: Apple's US trade-in page publishes a values table: iPhone 16 Pro Max up to $720, 16 Pro $630, 16 Plus $485, 16 $480. Headline reads 'Get $40-$720'. Every row says 'Up to'. Apple's own disclaimer: values vary by condition, year and configuration, and not all devices are eligible for credit. The real quote comes from the 'Find your trade-in value' flow. Timely: iPhone 18 launches Sept 9.
